prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1214; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are far more than the damage needs, about three times a normal estimate.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows heavy crush and scraping along the driver side, with the rear quarter panel and two door panels bent inward and the side glass cracked. Some of the lower rocker damage may not be from this impact, and I could not confirm that from the photos alone. Billing records show no repeated charges. The labor hours requested are far above what this damage calls for, roughly three times a typical estimate for this work, so I recommend a line-by-line review. No prior damage to this vehicle is on file. Plan: straighten panels, replace the cracked glass, and refinish the affected sections, with the questioned rocker repair held pending a re-inspection.
